title: The multiple transformed ZnO ENPs in the aquatic environment: the mechanisms of formation and ecotoxicological impact
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1127-1140
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00791G, Paper
Mikołaj Feculak, Susana Loureiro, Patrícia V. Silva, Fábio Yu Chen, Patryk Oleszczuk, Magdalena Kończak, Izabela Jośko
Sulphidation/phosphorylation and protein corona formation modify the morphology of ZnO ENPs, suppress Zn2+ release, and alter aggregation, reducing toxicity to D. magna and L. sativum by 20–90%, with the strongest effect under dual transformations.
